confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors are bounded estimates from aggregator, promotional and undated sources, not verified Newcastle menu surveys, so they are medium to low confidence. Beer and coffee are the firmest, with the national coffee average and a Newcastle pint of about A$12 as the anchors. Mid-range meal, inexpensive meal and wine are less certain. Cocktail is estimated from the local beer relationship (about 1.7 times a beer) because direct cocktail evidence was weak. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Newcastle context; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. The FX observation (0.6720 for 2026-11-18) comes from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rates overview and RSS feed; the RBA page itself was not opened directly. Five web searches were used, not six.
comparable_city_reasoning: Newcastle NSW is priced as a mid-sized Australian regional city, near Sydney but about 10% cheaper for restaurants per one comparison index. Estimates use Australian national averages for coffee and beer, Newcastle pub and bistro meal evidence, and Oceania mid-sized city lodging norms.
